jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Business Project Managers and IT Project Managers
to support cross-functional teams and ensure seamless execution of project workflows using Azure DevOps.
This role is pivotal in driving team alignment, maintaining visibility into progress, and fostering consistent project management practices. The ideal candidate is a natural collaborator with strong communication skills, capable of facilitating stand-ups and meetings, identifying blockers, and keeping stakeholders informed through clear reporting. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about enabling teams to deliver high-quality work on time, we’d love to meet you.

This position is a night shift work-from-home position with a usual schedule of 9am EST - 6pm EST.

Responsibilities
(include but are not limited to the following):
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and department-specific task boards using Azure DevOps
Coordinate tasks and resources across multiple teams to ensure alignment with goals and deadlines
Support development teams by facilitating stand-ups, meetings, and follow-ups
Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, maintaining smooth communication and progress tracking
Ensure team boards are up to date and clearly reflect current priorities and status
Assist in planning, deployment, and handover of completed work, including documentation and scheduling
Help identify risks, delays, and blockers, and work with leaders to resolve them
Prepare simple reports and updates for management on team/project progress
Champion consistency in work management practices and drive team collaboration
Guide teams in applying basic Agile principles to improve workflow and delivery

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, IT, Legal Studies, or related field—or equivalent experience
Minimum 4 years of experience in project management

Familiarity with project management tools, particularly Azure DevOps
, as well as others like Jira, Trello, or similar task boards
Strong organizational and communication skills with a detail-oriented mindset
Proficient in English (spoken and written) / Very Strong Communication
(American accent is a plus)
Comfortable working full-time on a night shift schedule
Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced setting
Knowledge of Agile or Scrum frameworks

Background supporting US-based clients or distributed teams
High Ownership; Cross-functional Technical Fluency; Experience Risk Management Practices and Operating in Fast-Paced Environments

Nice-to-Have:

Previous experience working on a night shift and remote setup
Has experience coordinating and delivering key cross-functional business initiatives at a high-level of impact and ownership
Scrum Master or PMP-related certification/training

jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager, Transformer Services
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Manage transformer service projects from planning through completion, overseeing scope, schedules, resources, budgets, vendors, and customer communication. The role coordinates cross-functional teams, addresses project risks and execution challenges, tracks performance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives. Project work supports the reliable maintenance and repair of transformer assets while helping ensure successful project execution, customer satisfaction, and compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Manage the full lifecycle of transformer service projects from initiation through closure.
Develop project plans, including scope, timelines, resource allocation, and budgets.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and third-party contractors.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, maintaining communication and managing expectations throughout project execution.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues while developing contingency plans.
Monitor project progress, track KPIs, and provide regular updates to management.
Manage project budgets, approve expenditures, and support cost-effective project delivery.
Support post-project reviews and continuous improvement of project management processes and tools within the Services Division.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

Your Background

Candidate must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for Hitachi Energy in the United States.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field, or an associate degree with more than seven years of experience in the transformer or substation field.
Minimum of five years of experience in project management with a focus on transformer services or heavy industrial equipment.
Experience delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
Understanding of transformer technology, maintenance, and repair processes preferred.
Proficiency with project management software, including MS Project or Primavera P6.
PMP or equivalent project management certification is highly desirable.

More About Us

This role offers exposure to transformer service projects, customer engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement within the Services Division.

Work on transformer service projects supporting the maintenance and repair of power infrastructure assets.
Collaborate with experienced professionals, including engineers, technicians, subcontractors, vendors, sales teams, and project stakeholders.
Participate in continuous improvement activities, post-project reviews, and the development of project management processes and tools.
Access learning and development opportunities through project execution, collaboration, and process improvement initiatives.
Health and retirement benefits are available as part of Hitachi Energy’s total rewards offerings.
Paid leave and flexible work programs are available in accordance with company policies.
Travel domestically and internationally to meet with customers, vendors, and sales teams.

Pay transparency statement

For applicants in Colorado, the expected salary range for this position is $118,400.00 - $148,000.00 USD annually. Actual compensation may vary based on factors permitted by law, including location, education, experience, skills, and business considerations. This position is also eligible for the benefits and other compensation programs made available to eligible employees.

jobs.title: People Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're hiring a People Project Manager
to join our HR PMO
and help deliver an ambitious portfolio of HR programs, products, and initiatives as we scale globally.

This is not a business-as-usual project management role
. We're a hypergrowth company building at speed, and our HR team is building alongside it. We're looking for someone who gets genuine energy from bringing order to chaos, creating structure where there isn't any yet, and getting important things shipped.

Hypergrowth, for real. Things move fast, priorities evolve, and there's always something meaningful to jump into. If you love pace, variety, and figuring things out as you go, you'll have a huge canvas here.
A chance to build. Our HR PMO is taking shape within a hugely ambitious HR team. You'll help create the workflows, rhythms, and tools we need to build a world-class function at scale.
Real ownership. Take projects from idea to delivery — creating structure, driving actions, managing dependencies, and keeping teams moving.
Global from day one. Work across our distributed HR team and with stakeholders around the world.

You'll Thrive If You

Create order from chaos: Turn fast-moving, ambiguous problems into clear plans and outcomes
Are relentlessly organized: Stay ahead of details, dependencies, decisions, and follow-ups
Love pace: Move quickly, adapt as things change, and keep momentum high
Build great workflows: Find simpler, smarter, more scalable ways to get things done
Collaborate brilliantly: Bring stakeholders together and create clarity across teams
Think and do: Build the plan, then roll up your sleeves to get it over the line

You'll Help Drive

HR projects: Manage programs and initiatives across our global HR roadmap
Planning & delivery: Build plans, milestones, workstreams, and clear ownership
Cross-functional execution: Coordinate across HR, Finance, Legal, IT, and other teams
Project governance: Drive decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned
Better ways of working: Build repeatable workflows and tools that help HR execute at scale

We're Looking For Someone Who

3+ years of experience: Project or program management in a fast-moving, high-growth organization
Is an excellent project manager: Can independently drive complex, multi-stakeholder projects from start to finish
Is hyper-organized: Exceptional attention to detail and strong systems for managing work
Builds, not just operates: Gets excited by creating something new rather than maintaining business as usual
Manages stakeholders well: Creates alignment and accountability without relying on authority
Communicates exceptionally: Produces crisp plans, updates, and documentation
Is pro-team: Collaborative, low-ego, and invested in making the whole team better

Location

This is a global, remote role
, working across our distributed HR organization and with stakeholders around the world.

Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How And Where We Work

Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

We are looking for two organized, detail-oriented Creative Project Managers
to join our growing Content team. In this role, you will be the operational backbone of our creative pods — keeping assets organized, workflows on track, and client deliverables polished. You will work at the intersection of project coordination and creative production, ensuring every piece of content that leaves the team meets our quality standards before it reaches the client.
If you thrive in fast-paced creative environments, love bringing order to complex workflows, and have a sharp eye for quality, we want to hear from you.

2+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, content coordination, or a similar role.
Strong ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
Experience organizing and maintaining digital assets and documentation.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Ability to review deliverables against brand guidelines and quality standards.
Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment with distributed teams.

Nice to Have
Hands-on experience using Asana for project and content management.
Familiarity with Figma for asset staging, review, or creative collaboration.
Previous experience working within a content, marketing, creative, or agency environment.
Experience supporting creative production teams and content workflows.
Understanding of content creation, digital marketing, or creative operations processes.

Responsibilities

Organize and maintain creative assets across multiple projects, ensuring proper naming conventions, version control, and accessibility.
Build, launch, and manage content plans within Asana while keeping timelines and priorities aligned.
Perform quality assurance reviews on content and creative deliverables before submission, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and brand consistency.
Coordinate project schedules, resource allocation, and communication across cross-functional teams.
Manage and stage visual assets within Figma for review, presentation, and production handoff.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, or delays.
Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance team productivity and workflow efficiency.
Serve as a key point of coordination between creative, strategy, and stakeholder-facing teams.
Track deadlines and ensure deliverables are completed on time and at a high standard.
Support content production operations and help maintain smooth day-to-day project execution.

What Success Looks Like
First 30 Days

Become familiar with active projects, asset libraries, and internal tools.

First 60–90 Days
Independently manage content plans and project timelines.
Conduct QA reviews with minimal supervision.
Coordinate cross-functional communication and support pod operations effectively.
Identify workflow improvements that increase team efficiency and delivery quality.

Success in this role will be measured by:
On-time project delivery
Quality and consistency of deliverables
Operational efficiency improvements
Team collaboration and communication effectiveness
Stakeholder satisfaction

Remote Work:
Work from anywhere—our team is global, and we value work-life balance.
Growth Opportunities:
As a key player i you’ll have the chance to shape your role and grow with us.

Join a team that is passionate about leveraging data to solve challenges and drive success in a rapidly evolving market.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Contact Center
jobs.description:
Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future

At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

The Role

Presidio is seeking an experienced, customer-facing Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex Contact Center and Unified Communications solutions within a Value-Added Reseller (VAR) and IT Systems Integrator environment. This role is accountable for the end-to-end execution of large-scale on-premises, hybrid, and cloud contact center implementations, often involving multiple technologies, vendors, and stakeholders across extended delivery timelines.

The Senior Project Manager owns project outcomes from contract handoff through production rollout and closeout, ensuring strict adherence to Statement of Work (SOW) scope, schedule, budget, margin targets, and customer satisfaction objectives.

Responsibilities Include

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Governance

Provide end-to-end ownership of all project phases including requirements validation, detailed planning, solution design coordination, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and formal project closeout.
Develop, maintain, and actively manage integrated project plans, including work breakdown structures, critical path analysis, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
Enforce project governance standards to ensure projects are delivered on time, within approved budget, and in alignment with contractual commitments.

Financial & Commercial Management

Own project financial performance, including revenue recognition alignment, cost tracking, billable utilization, and gross margin targets.
Monitor and control project labor, materials, and third-party costs; provide accurate forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
Partner with accounting and operations teams to ensure accurate project billing, cost allocation, and compliance with internal financial controls.

Resource & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional project teams consisting of Presidio engineering resources, solution architects, third-party vendors, and subcontractors.
Perform proactive resource planning in coordination with delivery leadership to ensure appropriate staffing, skills alignment, and capacity availability.
Act as the primary point of contact for customers, executive sponsors, internal leadership, and vendor partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Change, Risk & Quality Management

Identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, and mitigation strategies; escalate appropriately with clear impact analysis and recommended actions.
Lead formal change management processes, including scope change assessment, pricing impacts, schedule adjustments, and customer approvals.
Ensure all deliverables meet Presidio quality standards, contractual requirements, and customer expectations prior to acceptance.

Customer Engagement & Relationship Management

Drive clear, consistent, and professional communication through status reports, steering meetings, and executive briefings.
Proactively address client concerns, manage expectations, and resolve delivery challenges to maintain trust and long-term customer relationships.
Represent Presidio as a trusted advisor, reinforcing a consultative delivery approach that supports repeat business and account growth.

Technology Domain Awareness

Maintain working knowledge and experience with enterprise contact center and collaboration platforms to effectively manage solution delivery, risks, and dependencies, including:
Cisco Contact Center Express (UCCX) and Contact Center Enterprise (UCCE)
Cisco Unified Communications
Cisco Customer Voice Portal (CVP)
Webex Contact Center and Webex Contact Center Enterprise
AWS
Genesys
Five9
Twilio Flex
CCAI

Required Skills And Professional Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional or military experience.
7+ years of hands-on experience as a Senior Project Manager delivering complex, customer-facing technology implementation projects within a VAR, systems integrator, or professional services environment.
Demonstrated experience managing Contact Center and Unified Communications solutions, including cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments.
Proven ability to manage project financials, including margin, utilization, cost controls, and revenue alignment.
Strong command of formal project management methodologies, documentation, and governance practices.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Project for scheduling, dependency management, and critical path analysis.
PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification preferred.

Your future at Presidio

Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers - thinkers, builders, and collaborators - who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital world.

Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.

Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next-together.

About Presidio

Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.

At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio's expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, and enables actionable data insights and builds forward-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally. jobs.title: Project Manager - Advisory
jobs.description:
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, and completion of projects considering budget, timelines, resources, and task management. You will communicate transparently and in a timely manner with assigned Signant Health clients and internal stakeholders, managing project risks and ensuring timely resolution while reporting status with appropriate internal and external stakeholders. This role requires an effective leader who excels in problem-solving, can motivate a result-oriented team, and builds trust-based relationships with Signant Health clients. You will contribute to the implementation of company-wide process improvements to ensure effective and efficient project delivery.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

Manage and lead initial project delivery tasks, including the software development lifecycle (SDLC) of simple to medium complexity studies.
Ensure project systems are built and released in accordance with client expectations; lead the project system change control process.
Support implementation of complex, multi-product projects as needed.
Manage projects in accordance with established timelines, budgets, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
Review, approve, and maintain project and corporate systems and documentation.
Handle client escalations independently; work with internal and client teams to resolve issues and escalate as appropriate in a timely manner.
Serve as the primary contact for customers on assigned projects; ensure quality of communication with clients in terms of cadence, content, and audience.

HP delivers end-to-end solutions across the full MSD lifecycle—Define, Design, Deploy, Monitor, Manage, and Support phases—ensuring proactive experiences, optimized environments, and measurable business outcomes.

PMs are regarded as organizational leaders who frequently shape new ideas, influence process improvements, and represent HP to senior customer stakeholders. Their primary responsibility is leading the Deploy phase of the MSD lifecycle, ensuring that all aspects of deployment are executed seamlessly and in alignment with HP’s methodologies. They apply independent judgment within broadly defined policies to resolve complex issues involving technical, operational, financial, and organizational elements.

Job Summary

The PM leads the end‑to‑end deployment and transition of managed print environments, ensuring alignment to contractual scope, timeline, budget, and quality expectations. The PM applies advanced project management expertise, drives strategic alignment, and ensures accountability across HP and customer organizations.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Section:
Facility Design and Construction

Department:
Community Infrastructure

Initial Reporting Location:
Tom Davies Square

Job Status:
Contract positions

Estimated Probable Duration:
Three (3) years

Number of Vacancies:
2

Union Affiliation:
Non-union

Hours of Work:
70 hours bi-weekly

Shift Work Required:
No

Range of Pay:
Group 13 - $4,085.90 to $4,809.70 bi-weekly

The start date will follow the selection process.

This position is eligible for hybrid work . Hybrid work arrangements are operational and incumbent based. The successful candidate will be required to work on-site at a City of Greater Sudbury location a minimum of three days per week and must be able to report to a City of Greater Sudbury work location within two hours when required.

Main Function

Reporting to the Manager of Facility Design and Construction, this position is responsible to coordinate and direct the activities of project team members and/or consultants, set objectives, provide guidance for complex issues and manage facility projects from conception and initial design to final construction completion and warranty expiration.

Objectives

Lead and coordinate project delivery to achieve successful outcomes within approved scope, budget, schedule, and quality, while complying with applicable legislation, City policies, and project management practices.
Build and maintain collaborative stakeholder relationships to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery.

Duties

Provide regular financial, schedule and project status reports through all phases of the project.
Develop, coordinate and implement project management tools including project charter, project schedule, work breakdown structure and stakeholder, risk, communication, quality, commissioning and transition plans.
Responsible for the preparation, coordination and oversight of procurement instruments including design (RPF’s, RFQ’s), setting specifications and preparing cost estimates.
Track, document and report on pertinent project information as defined by the Project Management Plan.
Recommend human resource requirements and participate in the allocation of project delivery team members such as designers, inspectors, consultants, etc.
In conjunction with project delivery team, carry out project work in accordance with expectations of the Project Management Plan to deliver projects on time, on budget and to the required quality standard.
Coordinate and direct the activities of team members. Issue directions and sanctions to external resources as necessary.
Conduct site visits to ensure work is consistent with contract documents, project objectives, regulations and policies.
Coordinate, schedule, prepare agendas, produce minutes and Chair project meetings.
Identify, investigate, evaluate and take actions as necessary to mitigate project risks.
Approve progress payments. Process contemplated changes in project requirements (e.g., scope, schedules, quality, cost, specifications, contract terms), manage contractor requests and inquiries in accordance with relevant City policies and present project issues objectively for consideration by applicable stakeholder.
Ensure Construction Data Records (e.g. commissioning documents, as-built drawings, etc.) are accurate, complete and updated within required time frames.
Ensure that commissioning, closeout and warranty review processes are completed.
Ensure quality control/quality assurance testing is conducted and records are maintained as part of the project documentation.
Develop presentation materials, coordinate and attend public consultation sessions. Liaise with affected stakeholders to discuss and resolve concerns. Mediate disputes between project participants.
Act as City’s representative for project-related litigation matters. Liaise with Legal Services, Risk Management, City’s insurance adjuster and other stakeholders on matters relating to claims and other project disputes.
Develop and maintain a thorough working knowledge of City’s Health and Safety policies and the applicable provincial legislation listed therein, ensuring due diligence is maintained.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education and Training:

University degree in a related discipline from a recognized university with Canadian accreditation.
Additional education initiatives to update and expand competencies.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is an asset.
Membership in the Professional Engineers of Ontario (PEO) is an asset.

Experience:

Minimum of three (3) years of directly related and responsible experience.
Municipal and public sector experience a definite asset.
Experience coordinating project delivery teams an asset.
Experience in the co-ordination of employees and work assignments as well as dealing with the general public.

Or

Education And Training:

College diploma in a related discipline from a recognized community college with Canadian accreditation.
Additional education initiatives to update and expand competencies.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is an asset.
Certification through OACETT as a Certified Engineering Technologist is an asset.

Experience:

Minimum of five (5) years of directly related and responsible experience.
Municipal and public sector experience a definite asset.
Experience coordinating project delivery teams an asset.
Experience in the co-ordination of employees and work assignments as well as dealing with the general public.

Knowledge Of:

Project delivery and standardized project management methods.
Related general civil and mechanical design principles and practices on multi-discipline projects.
Applicable legislation and regulations, as well as City policies and procedures.
Best practices within areas of responsibility.
Proven ability to work with computer software systems including engineering, project management, scheduling and word processing software.
Quality control, quality assurance, project commissioning and closeout related to projects.

Abilities To:

Understand and meet the needs of stakeholders.
Establish effective working relationships with stakeholders including staff, City Council, contractors, consultants, external agencies and members of the public.
Write reports, correspondence, briefing notes and develop presentation materials.
Coordinate and manage the financial, human and physical resources in an efficient and sustainable manner.
Prepare contract documents and have an understanding of contract law.
Manage conflict, mediate disputes, negotiate change orders and assist in reaching consensus.
Adjust to shifting priorities and deadlines. Balance conflicting demands from stakeholders.
Create enthusiasm and motivation for project delivery teams to pursue City’s service level targets.
Identify and mitigate risks.
Lead and participate with change management.
Advocate, promote and implement best practices.

Personal Suitability:

Ability to perform the essential duties of the position.
Demonstrated reliability, professionalism, and accountability in meeting job responsibilities.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Personal commitment to address demands from internal and external stakeholders.

Language:

Excellent use of English; verbally and in writing.

Other Requirements:

Must be physically capable of operating a vehicle safely, possess a valid Class G driver’s license, and have an acceptable driving record.

Competencies:
Competency Library - Level 2 Proficiency (Individual Contributor)

This job is also being posted as a development opportunity. Should there be no fully qualified candidate for this position, a candidate who can be expected to meet the required qualifications within a reasonable period of time may be considered for this position as a development opportunity.

Development opportunity range of pay: $3,714.20 to $4,371.50 bi-weekly. The successful candidate will be paid at the reduced range until the minimum qualifications have been met.

jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a Staff Program Manager who is passionate about bringing planning rigor and scalable operational excellence to marketing — including shaping how we operate in the era of AI.

As a Staff Program Manager, Marketing Operations at DigitalOcean, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing and AI. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Operations, you’ll be marketing leadership’s trusted planning partner — turning priorities into operating cadences, decision-ready materials, and clear owners, milestones, and outcomes. You’ll own planning and cross-functional coordination across marketing programs, co-owning execution alongside functional leads — for example, partnering with our Product Marketing Lead to bring the programmatic rigor that keeps product launches on track. Beyond individual programs, you’ll help shape how marketing operates as a team, including where AI-powered tools can drive more scalable, efficient ways of working.

Own planning and cross-functional coordination for marketing programs, co-owning execution with functional leads (e.g., partnering with Product Marketing on launch planning and execution) to keep initiatives moving from kickoff to completion.
Build and run operating cadences with marketing leadership (status reviews, business reviews, planning cycles) that keep priorities, risks, dependencies, and next steps visible.
Help define how marketing operates together — establishing the operating model, rituals, and ways of working that scale as the team and its remit grow.
Partner across marketing's functions, along with product, sales, engineering, finance, and partner teams, to align roadmaps, launches, and go-to-market plays with measurable business outcomes.
Track budget, resourcing, and approval workflows in support of program and partnership investments, surfacing risks and decision points to marketing leadership.
Lead co-marketing and cross-functional program execution for partner- and customer-facing initiatives (e.g., events, campaigns, customer storytelling), connecting product content to field and business outcomes.
Synthesize inputs from product, technical, partner, and customer stakeholders into decision-ready briefings, dashboards, and KPI reporting for marketing leadership.
Help shape marketing operations for the AI era — identifying and implementing AI-powered tools and workflows that drive scalable operational and programmatic excellence.

Key Metrics

On-time delivery rate for marketing programs and campaign launches
Stakeholder satisfaction with program management and planning support
Program cycle time from kickoff to launch
Budget and resourcing forecast accuracy
Roadmap adherence and reduction in scope churn

Compensation Range

$150,000 - $190,000
This is a remote role

JR: 2026-8093

Why You’ll Like Working for DigitalOcean

We innovate with purpose. You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.
We prioritize career development. At DO, you’ll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000+ courses to support their continued growth and development.
We care about your well-being. Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences.
We reward our employees. The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Marauder
jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

Saronic Technologies is seeking a Program Manager to own the execution and delivery of Marauder, our 180-foot Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV) produced at our Franklin, LA shipyard. This is a flagship large-scale production program, and the Program Manager is accountable for its cost, schedule, scope, and customer outcomes from contract award through delivery and sustainment.

Marauder is built at production scale and fielded across a wide and evolving range of complex missions. The Program Manager must pair deep expertise in large-scale shipbuilding and rate production with an instinct for modular kits, payloads, and mission-package integration—understanding how a common hull is configured, re-configured, and sustained to meet diverse customer needs. This role owns the balance between production throughput and mission flexibility.

The Program Manager serves as the primary customer-facing owner of the program, partnering closely with the internal Saronic growth, engineering, production and quality teams. The right candidate brings the customer fluency to manage government stakeholders and contracts, the technical acumen to make technical decisions aligned to the customer needs and contract requirements, and the programmatic discipline to deliver a large, complex platform at scale.

Responsibilities

Program Ownership & Delivery

Own end-to-end execution of the Marauder program, holding accountability for cost, schedule, scope, and quality from award through delivery and sustainment.
Serve as a leader and owner of the customer contract, deliverables, milestones, CDRLs, and contractual obligations.
Build and maintain the integrated program plan, aligning productions scheduled, engineering milestones, and integration timelines to customer commitments.
Drive risk and opportunity management across the program, escalating and resolving issues that threaten cost, schedule, or performance.
Report program health, forecasts, and decisions to Saronic leadership and customer stakeholders.

Large-Scale Production Interface

Partner with the Franklin production team to plan and execute rate production of a 180-foot ASV, from long-lead procurement through hull construction, outfitting, and delivery.
Monitor build sequencing, work breakdown, and production milestones to protect throughput while meeting quality and acceptance criteria.
Monitor and mitigate production risks—supply chain, labor, tooling, and facility constraints—unique to large-vessel shipbuilding.
Coordinate with Quality and Production to ensure build configurations and acceptance events meet customer and contractual standards.

Kit & Mission Package Integration

Own the configuration strategy for Marauder across a variety of mission packages, kits, and payloads on a common production hull.
Partner with Mission Package Integration Managers to plan integration of bespoke and commercial-off-the-shelf kits into the production and delivery flow.
Balance production standardization against mission-driven variance, protecting throughput while enabling flexibility.
Ensure integration timelines, dependencies, and configuration baselines are reflected in the master program plan.
Capture mission-package lessons learned and feed them back into production and product roadmaps.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer, managing expectations, requirements, and relationships across the program lifecycle.
Elicit and clarify evolving mission needs, translating them into actionable program and technical direction.
Lead program reviews, delivery events, and technical exchanges with government stakeholders, operators, and evaluators.
Deliver clear, concise program updates and after-action reporting to leadership and customer audiences.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Direct and synchronize a cross-functional program team spanning Production, Engineering, Software, Mission Services, and Forward Deployed Engineering.
Partner with Technical Program Managers to align technical execution with programmatic commitments.
Make and defend tradeoff decisions across capability, schedule, cost, and risk.
Drive disciplined configuration management across vessels, kits, payloads, and software versions

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related technical field.
10+ years of experience in program management of large-scale production, shipbuilding, or complex defense development programs. Program Management experience of Unmanned Surface Vessels highly desirable.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interface confidently with technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ownership of cost, schedule, and scope on programs of significant size and complexity.
Experience managing production at rate, including supply chain, build sequencing, and delivery of large or complex hardware systems highly desirable.
Proven ability to manage government or defense customers, contracts, and deliverables.
Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.
Secret security clearance eligibility required, active preferred.

Key Competencies

Can own a large, complex program end-to-end while balancing production throughput against mission flexibility.
Can connect production and configuration decisions to overall program cost, schedule, and mission outcomes.
Can translate evolving customer requirements into disciplined, executable program plans.
Leadership of high-performing, cross-functional, and distributed teams.
Established track record of clear, consistent, and correct communications with peers, leaders, and external stakeholders.
Comfort guiding customers through ambiguous or evolving requirements and shaping actionable solutions.

Physical Demands

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Occasional standing and walking within the office
Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment
Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports
Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies
Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

Benefits

Medical Insurance:
Comprehensive health insurance plans covering a range of services

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

Dental and Vision Insurance:
Coverage for routine dental check-ups, orthodontics, and vision care

Saronic pays 100% of the premium under the basic plan for employees and 80% for dependents

Time Off:
Generous PTO and Holidays

Parental Leave:
Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents

Competitive Salary:
Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses

Retirement Plan:
401(k) plan with company match

Stock Options:
Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

Life and Disability Insurance:
Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

Pet Insurance:
Discounted pet insurance options including 24/7 Telehealth helpline

Additional Perks:
Free lunch benefit and unlimited free drinks and snacks in the office

jobs.title: Subcontracts Program Manager II
jobs.description:
Job Description

Primary program POC with management responsibility and overall cost/schedule/technical accountability for a single major/critical subcontract, or portfolio of large program subcontracts performance, risk management and tracking. Plan, organize, direct, and control significant program subcontract management activities in support of an SMS proposal or program. Ensure supplier execution of all subcontract requirements for cost, schedule, technical, and mission assurance. Additionally, maintain positive internal and external relations with the BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) customer, the program team, and the supplier(s).

The Operations Strategic Capabilities Unit plays a fundamental role in enabling efficient business and program execution – from strategic capital investments, industrial operations and an efficient supply chain, to state-of-the-art manufacturing and test operations and top-notch facilities management.

The Integrated Supply Chain team has a direct impact on program success, acting as a critical chain that links the end-to-end material flow together. Our organization helps propel us forward and achieve true mission partnership.

What You’ll Do

Responsible for overall leadership and management of a single program subcontract or a portfolio of program subcontracts, with clear lines of authority defined at the program level. Primary Program POC to all Program subcontract stakeholders with responsibility for subcontract cost, schedule, technical, quality, and all deliverables going to/from subcontractor(s).
Participate in proposal preparation activities in support of new business capture opportunities with existing and/or new subcontractors, customers, and programs. Coordinate compilation of supplier RFP packages to align to customer proposal scope, timelines, and objectives. Coordinate SME inputs to technical evaluations of complex subcontractor proposals, assessing realism, reasonableness, and completeness.
May lead development of Program Subcontract Management Plan (PSMP).
Lead the program Subcontract Management Team (SMT) and aligns with the program to ensure the SMT is staffed with appropriate skill levels and that internal work is being accomplished according to plan in support of the subcontract management plan.
Ensure program mission requirements, purposes, objectives, and expectations are communicated and flowed to the subcontractor(s). Responsible for development and execution of subcontract: management plan, scope of work, technical requirements, mission assurance requirements, milestones, SDRLs and any other subcontract(s) deliverables necessary.
Responsible for all subcontract(s) deliverables to the various program levels, as applicable.
Program level budgetary authority for subcontract execution including profit/loss, labor budget, management reserve, and all aspects of oversight and management of the subcontract(s).
Responsible for subcontract cost tracking, Earned Value (EV) and EAC budget, variance tracking and reporting requirements, including management, and monitoring timely supplier financial reporting.
Ensure visibility and communication of subcontract technical, quality assurance, financial, schedule, and compliance to Program reporting requirements.
Responsible for subcontract schedule and program level schedule margin specific to the subcontract(s). Ensure supplier IMS is integrated into the Program level IMS.
Manage the subcontract(s) risks including subcontract(s) cost, schedule, technical and quality risks. Responsible for deconflicting resource and schedule conflicts at subcontractor(s) location. Responsibility and know-how to leverage program and SMS team in achieving efficient conflict resolution.
Responsible for subcontract(s) change control and management. Support change proposal efforts for subcontract(s) including pre-coordination with subcontractor(s) to establish expectations. Lead internal evaluation of subcontractor(s) change proposals and development of negotiation plans
In partnership with the Subcontract Manager (SMS’ empowered official for the subcontract), act as the principal interface with the subcontractor on all subcontract related subjects and perform as a liaison between subcontractor, Program, and other stakeholders as needed.
Work closely with and assist Subcontract Manager to ensure Subcontract is maintained current and meets Program requirements. Establish SMS programmatic negotiation position and support subcontract negotiations.
Work closely with Program Management and customer to communicate subcontractor progress, resolve issues and concerns, and identify and manage subcontractor risk.
Coordinate the participants, schedule, logistics, and success criteria and chair subcontractor program status, business, design, manufacturing, test and pre-ship reviews, including inclusion of Customer participation.
May develop and manage a complete Subcontractor Performance system to tie past performance, current requirements, and subcontract documentation and management into predictive subcontractor performance model.
Ensure that all business is conducted using the highest ethical standards and in compliance with all applicable laws, statutes, and regulations.
Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.
Perform other duties as necessary.

On-Site Work Environment:

This position requires regular in-person engagement by working

on-site five days

each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non-company locations may be required.

Working Conditions

Work is performed in an office environment, laboratory, cleanroom, or production floor.

Short Term Incentive:

Subject to business performance and recommendations of management, this role may be eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

BS/BA in related field plus 10 or more years related experience.
Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.
A current, active Top Secret/SCI security clearance is required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI Polygraph.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $134640 - $228888

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, Space & Mission Systems is a leading provider of national defense and civil space applications, advanced remote sensing, scientific and tactical systems for government and commercial customers. We continually pioneer ways to innovate spacecraft, mission payloads, optical systems, and other defense and civil capabilities. Powered by endlessly curious people with an unwavering mission focus, we continually discover ways to enable our customers to perform beyond expectation and protect what matters most.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Multiple positions may be available on this opening.

As a Senior Technology Project Manager, you will be responsible for partnering with the Office of the CTO to execute large, enterprise-wide programs and provide delivery leadership across multiple concurrent initiatives in an agile environment at our Costa Mesa, CA office. You will own outcomes end-to-end—driving alignment across teams that don’t report to you, surfacing tradeoffs, and ensuring executive stakeholders have the clarity they need to make decisions.

What You’ll Do:

Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise technology programs (Infrastructure, Information Security, and/or Application Development) from intake through launch and stabilization.
Define and own integrated project planning across multiple workstreams: scope, milestones, critical path, resourcing, and delivery metrics.
Drive cross-team dependency management across engineering, product, information security, operations, and business stakeholders.
Establish and run project governance, including steering committee cadence, stakeholder alignment, decision logs, escalation paths, and RACI as needed.
Own and actively manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), ensuring proactive mitigation and timely escalation.
Facilitate execution in an Agile / hybrid environment, removing blockers, aligning priorities, and ensuring teams deliver against commitments.
Deliver concise, executive-ready communication: status, risks, tradeoffs, and decision requests to senior leadership.
Manage change effectively by controlling scope and timelines, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring impacts are understood and approved.
Maintain high-quality project artifacts (plans, timelines, RAID logs, meeting notes, action items, milestone reviews, launch readiness).
Identify opportunities to improve delivery operations and contribute to the continuous improvement of project management practices across the organization.

What You’ll Need:

Extensive project/program management experience delivering technical initiatives in enterprise environments.
Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs with multiple cross-functional teams and significant dependencies.

This role is based in Nashville, TN. This role will require relocation to Nashville, TN if you do not reside in the region.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished Lead Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) and Server Operations programs across parts of North America.

This Lead Principal TPM will provide strategic and operational program leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix support, and automation across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish scalable program mechanisms that enable rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, workforce effectiveness, and technical rigor. This leader will partner across engineering and operations teams, standardize execution across multiple sites, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and data-driven program management.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions while improving the systems, tools, and operating rhythms that support reliable cloud infrastructure at scale.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and technically strong program leader with a proven track record of driving large-scale infrastructure, cloud operations, and automation programs through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations execution across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide program leadership for Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations initiatives across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix operations, and operational automation.
Develop and execute scalable program frameworks capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple sites and cross-functional teams.
Lead complex, geographically distributed programs that improve operational performance, safety, security, availability, and service quality across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. Credence has an immediate opening for a Program Manager B-2 at the senior to support the B-2 Division who is responsible for the modernization, test, production, fielding and sustainment of B-2 aircraft and related systems.  The B-2 is a high demand, low density fleet that is 20+ years old, is undergoing numerous concurrent acquisitions to solve obsolescence issues, and delivers critical aerial denial/anti-access and nuclear capabilities at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

Apply knowledge and experience in acquisition program management policies and procedures to USAF systems, subsystems, and equipment procurement activities, post-award project/program management tasks, and acquisition programs throughout their life cycles
Apply a full range of acquisition program management policies and procedures to perform acquisition management activities in support of existing and future F/B Directorate aircraft programs and platforms

Develop and coordinate responses to taskers related to internal and external program inquiries
Support warfighter Urgent Operational Needs (UON) and Joint Urgent Operational Needs (JUON) execution teams by recommending accelerated test concepts, minimum integration levels, and trade-offs among risk, schedule, performance, and cost

Assist in performing MSAs leading up to design reviews and support the development of draft documentation and presentation materials based on cost, schedule, and performance limits

Evaluate contractor-proposed schedules against Government schedules, assess program office schedules against schedule databases, and support probabilistic and deterministic schedule risk assessments, including Schedule Risk Assessments (SRAs) using Monte Carlo simulation-based tools
Develop program management strategies and support Business Case Analyses (BCAs), Cost of Ownership (COO) analyses, aging aircraft analyses, process documentation, PWSs, SOWs, Data Item Descriptions (DIDs), test plans, acquisition plans, LCMPs, LCSPs, ELMPs, QASPs, ASPs, IMPs, IMSs, AIPs, and AIMPs
Support development of contract strategies, Work Breakdown Structures (WBSs), program risk assessments, market survey requirements, executive briefings, stakeholder coordination, briefing updates, and meeting minutes

Provide inputs, draft, coordinate, adjudicate comments, and produce final coordinated milestone documents and assessments, including staff summary packages for milestone approval

Translate user requirements documents, including Capability Development Documents (CDDs), Capability Production Documents (CPDs), and CONOPs, into Request for Proposal (RFP) documentation for the F/B Directorate

Assist with Automated Business Services System (ABSS), System Management Analysis Reporting Tool (SMART), and Integrated Budget Documentation and Execution System (IDECS), including producing documents using IDECS

Communicate across multiple platforms, programs, phases, and enterprises while supporting integration of intelligence information and infrastructure for cross-enterprise capabilities planning and system acquisition
Support establishment of a capability architect function to develop integrated architectures for cross-enterprise comparison, analysis, and integration
Identify and advocate AF Operational Support (OS) capability requirements and support OS transformation through capability-based planning, modernization initiatives, process engineering, and integration of intelligence from concept development through sustainment

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems’ Advance Programs Operating Unit, is currently seeking a Program Manager 1
to provide program leadership to our Carbon-Carbon team, on-site at our Promontory, Utah
site.

Overview

This Program Manager (PM) will support the management of the Common Hypersonic Glide Body contracts (C-HGB). Northrop Grumman manufactures the thermal protection system for the C-HGB program which is used on the Army’s Dark Eagle and Navy’s Conventional Prompt Strike programs. This is an exciting and challenging time for the program as we advance from prototyping to production and accelerate delivery of this critical capability. The PM will be responsible for program success by integrating cost, schedule, and technical performance through cross-functional leadership and proactive management.

Role And Responsibilities

Finance: Profit and loss accountability through proactive management of expenditures and monthly reporting; lead cost-savings initiatives
Schedule: Oversee execution of integrated team activities to achieve program milestones
Contracts Management: Ensure execution activities are within contract requirements and manage scope creep
Risk and Opportunity Management: Mitigation of program risks and realization of opportunities
Stakeholder Leadership: Manage messaging and relationships with executive leadership, customers, prime contractors, industry partners, and suppliers.
Strategy and Growth: Identify opportunities for additional scope, follow-on contracts and new customers; Support proposal management, preparation and submittals
